description: [Free] Stores a connection under an alias — the URL and, optionally, a credential kept encrypted on this account — and REPLACES the alias if it already exists, which changes what every format naming it will call on its next run. This tool itself calls nothing: a format's resolvers use the connection only when preview_episode or run_show runs it. Formats refer to the alias only, so a format never carries a secret and is safe to publish or fork. Nothing is called now.

alias.description: The name a format's resolvers use: {"mcp": "finance_ds", ...}. Letters, digits, underscore.

kind.description: mcp: JSON-RPC tools/call. http: plain JSON endpoints under this base.

note.description: What this server is, for the list.

secret.description: A bearer token or API key sent as Authorization: Bearer. Stored encrypted, never returned, never in a format.

url.description: The server's public http(s) address: an MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP) or an http API base.

name: register_mcp_connection
title: Name an upstream server for resolvers
